title: Fanin of a combined circuit
statement: For any number $n$ of variables, any Boolean gate type, and any finite list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on those variables, the maximum fanin of the circuit obtained by combining the list is at most the maximum of $2$ and the largest fanin among the circuits in $cs$, where the largest fanin of an empty list is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
